senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. רבק in רִבְקָה I)to join.—Denom. מַרְפֵּק.
to join one’s self; (with על, cmp. חָבִיב) to endear one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> (they were childless for some time) <he>כדי שיהיו מִתְרַפְּקוֹת … בנויין</he> (Ar. <he>מתפרקדות</he>, corr. acc.) in order that they might endear themselves to their husbands through their beauty; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 986:17">Yalk. Cant. 986</cite> (some ed. <he>מתפרקות</he>, corr. acc.); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14:8">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite> <he>כדי שלא יהו וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>מתרפקת</he>, read: <he>מִתְפָּרֶקֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01980"><he>פָּרַק</he></cite>.]
